ui.staff_correction.title: Correct source notes (local OMR candidate)
ui.staff_correction.help: Compare the source page and enter explicit pitches and rhythms. MIDI 60=C4, A2=45, E3=52. Onsets/durations use quarter-note beats; measure indices are rows in the measure table. Changing measure length shifts later measures; changing meter does not alter notes or length automatically. Complete every field in new rows. Accept creates a corrected copy; Cancel leaves the original project unchanged.
ui.staff_correction.local_only: Note correction requires a local OMR candidate with complete staff events and written measures.
ui.staff_correction.missing_fields: Complete pitch, measure index, onset, duration, staff, and voice ID.
ui.staff_correction.invalid_integer: Pitch, measure number, staff, and meter fields must be integers.
ui.staff_correction.invalid_beats: Beat values must be finite, nonnegative, and exactly representable at 480 ticks per quarter note; rhythms are not rounded automatically.
ui.staff_correction.invalid_position: The measure index or note onset lies outside the written measures.
ui.staff_correction.invalid_measure: Measure length must be positive and at most 256 quarter-note beats; meter, measure number, or source-page identity is invalid.
ui.staff_correction.invalid_note: Pitch must be MIDI 0–127; staff, nonempty voice ID, onset, or duration is invalid.
ui.staff_correction.bar_bound: A note crosses the measure boundary. Edit or delete it explicitly; notes are not clipped and ties are not guessed.
ui.staff_correction.note_limit: The note set is empty or exceeds correction limits; the measure count must stay unchanged.
ui.staff_correction.clef_bound: A source clef change lies outside the shortened measure; correction does not guess or move its local position.
ui.staff_correction.repeat_bound: An original repeat boundary is outside the corrected material or has no exact position; retain explicit timing inside the boundary.
ui.staff_correction.invalid_performance: The corrected practice guide, sound ties, or complete playback timing is invalid.
ui.staff_correction.media_binding: This candidate also binds original audio or generated accompaniment; source-score correction does not change their synchronization.
ui.staff_correction.manual_notice: This material contains explicit user note/measure edits, not automatic model corrections or confirmation of whole-score accuracy. Continue source-page comparison and audition. Pre-edit diagnostics remain in the manual-correction record.
ui.staff_correction.lyrics_changed: Some original lyrics no longer map to the highest practice line. Their text remains in the manual-correction record; review the mapping.
ui.staff_correction.unresolved_remaining: Unresolved sound ties remain with their original marks. Audition their independent written durations and continue reviewing them.
ui.staff_correction.overfull: Current measure %1 still has %2 beats where its meter expects %3. All notes and excess time remain for review.
ui.staff_correction.duplicate_number: Printed measure number %1 is still duplicated; page order and notes were not changed automatically.
